Row.Text: The locals in this area has numbered to a small amount of tribal natives. They have no desire to assimilate into our culture. What do you suppose we do?
They were here first, we must respect their wishes and expand around them.
If we don't claim the land, someone else will. Relocate them onto reservations.
You can never have too many slaves. Seize their land.
